name: api-contract-specification
description: Produce a machine-readable API contract: OpenAPI 3.1 for REST, AsyncAPI 3.0 for event/streaming, GraphQL SDL for GraphQL, proto files for gRPC. Resource / operation coverage, schema with examples, error responses, security schemes, servers, tags, reusable components. Contract-first workflow: spec before code. Lint rules (Spectral / Redocly) checklist. Versioning hand-off. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
